title: Gregorian Hadrianum (Wilson 1915): complete strict Canon Missae constituent — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Complete strict Eucharistic Canon in H. A. Wilson's 1915 critical edition main text (base MS R = Vatican Reg. lat. 337, collated with C = Cambrai 164 and O = Vat. Ott. 313): printed pp. 2-4, PDF pp. 60-62, from Te igitur immediately after Sanctus through per omnia saecula saeculorum . amen. immediately before Oremus / Pater noster. Note that Wilson's main text of R omits Memento defunctorum (recorded only in apparatus note 14 for O and a 12th-century marginal addition in R); apparatus footnotes are excluded.

pages.description: Front matter, introduction, and printed p. 1 (PDF p. 59: Ordo rubric, Sursum corda, Vere dignum).
Printed p. 2 (PDF p. 60): end of Preface/Sanctus excluded; strict Canon Te igitur through start of Quam oblationem; footnotes excluded.
Printed p. 3 (PDF p. 61): completion of Quam oblationem through start of Nobis quoque (Memento defunctorum absent from main text); footnotes excluded.
Printed p. 4 (PDF p. 62): completion of Nobis quoque through per omnia saecula saeculorum. amen.; Oremus/Pater noster/Libera nos and footnotes excluded.
Remainder of Sacramentary, Supplement, appendices and indices.
